_description: Algorithm parameters that reproduce coherence_analysis_ephys_calcium.py exactly.

_notes.coherence_nperseg_seconds: null means use scipy default (256 samples). The original script calls scipy.signal.coherence(sig1, sig2, fs=fr) with no nperseg, so scipy uses its built-in default of 256 samples.
_notes.normalization_method: The original script does NOT z-score normalize signals before computing stats. 'none' matches this behaviour. (Normalization is only relevant for scatter_correlation analysis, not coherence_ephys_calcium.)
_notes.edge_trim_seconds: 5.0 seconds matches eeg_calcium_scatter_plots.py (FILTER_CONFIG edge_trim_seconds=5.0). Only scatter_correlation applies this; coherence_ephys_calcium ignores it entirely.
_notes.spectrogram_verbose: The original compute_power() passes verbose=True to multitaper_spectrogram. Our implementation passes verbose=False to suppress output. This does not affect computed values.
